description: A delay that plays each stretch between triggers back an octave down and then runs it up to catch the input again

params.text: Sets the pitch the upper playback speed is tuned to, 0 to 11 semitones above the input
Adds up to 100 cents to the upper playback speed

inputs.text: The signal written into the delay
Starts a new recording on each rising edge above 2V, reading low again below 0.1V

outputs.text: 10V while the delay is playing back at the upper speed and 0V while it is playing back an octave down
The recorded stretch played back, an octave down to begin with and then at the speed the two knobs set until it catches the input

notes: nothing comes out until a trigger is patched to TRIG; with no trigger the buffer fills, resets itself and the output falls quiet
the delay buffer is shared out between the polyphonic channels, so the longest stretch one channel can hold falls as the channel count rises

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
high above 2V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
